scope: Cumulative allocator stack deltas between ready/dripped gates for the256-peer quiet diagnostic. Native PIE load base comes from the zero-offset executable mapping in the heap capture; GNU addr2line resolves retained function symbols from each exact frozen binary. Debug lines are stripped, so function names are attribution context, not source line evidence. Every profile row is summed against its header. Whole requested counts include fixed management overhead; only the Connection::drive stack isolates upgrade-box allocations. No CPU or timing claim.
